author: mara
story: Mara drafts an outage notice for a faulted German charge point from its live status (fast model, facts only), reads it, and posts it to the European field ops Teams channel. The post goes through ctx.confirm with the full text in the summary, and she confirms it.

input.text: DE*EDR*E1001 (Essen Ruettenscheid) is out of service with a ground failure. A technician is booked; expected back tomorrow afternoon.
